name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for CPA firms?

mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for CPA firms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO for CPA firms primarily focuses on ranking web pages in organic search results based on keywords and links, driving traffic to your site. AEO, however, targets direct answers and rich snippets provided by AI-driven search engines. While SEO aims for clicks to your website, AEO strives for your firm's information to be the authoritative answer delivered directly within the search interface. This requires a deeper understanding of semantic search, entity relationships, and natural language processing to ensure your content is understood and utilized by AI models. Both are crucial, but AEO addresses the evolving search landscape.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO for CPAs targets direct answers in AI search engines, while traditional SEO focuses on website rankings and clicks. AEO prioritizes being the authoritative answer.
